constant_nk.name: constant_nk
domain_requirements: n>0 and k>=0 on requested grid
error_assumptions: constant over declared wavelength domain; no empirical material error bound
constant_nk.cost_model: deterministic array operation; metered enclosing forward

layer.name: layer
domain_requirements: nonnegative physical thickness including shared bias
layer.cost_model: deterministic array operation; metered enclosing forward

stack.name: stack
domain_requirements: ordered planar finite layers and final semi-infinite substrate
error_assumptions: no lateral structure or roughness model
stack.cost_model: deterministic array operation; metered enclosing forward

tmm.name: tmm
domain_requirements: external incidence below grazing; s/p intensity only
error_assumptions: finite angular quadrature; shared Maxwell assumptions; not empirical validation
tmm.cost_model: number of polarization x aperture solver calls and wavelength points; layer count additionally affects measured wall time

summary.probability_semantics: deterministic forwards; stochastic likelihood and prior must be declared separately
summary.scientific_validation: contracts and numerical tests do not replace expert/empirical signoff
